title: The Answer Lies Within: Self-Derived Rewards Enable Explainable Relation Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2510.06198v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite the remarkable reasoning capabilities of large language models, they still struggle with one-shot relation extraction without predefined relation labels. We identify two pitfalls: models are often misled by irrelevant tokens instead of relation-conveying semantics, and they often fail to align with the abstraction level human annotators expect. We introduce a novel framework that closes this gap with two components: (1) COGRE, a cognitively-inspired reasoning framework that structures RE into a series of processes mimicking human text-processing; and (2) HIT@DICT, a reinforcement learning intermediate reward strategy that encourages reasoning to align with relational labels by rewarding relation-relevant phrases in reasoning. translated_title: 答案蕴于其中：自我衍生奖励实现可解释关系抽取
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.06198v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：尽管大型语言模型具有卓越的推理能力，但在没有预定义关系标签的情况下进行单样本（one-shot）关系抽取仍然存在困难。我们识别出两个问题：模型常常被无关的词元（token）误导，而非关注传达关系的语义；并且模型往往无法与人类标注者所期望的抽象层次保持一致。我们提出了一个新颖的框架，通过两个组件来弥合这一差距：(1) COGRE，一个受认知启发的推理框架，将关系抽取结构化为一系列模仿人类文本处理的过程；(2) HIT@DICT，一种强化学习中间奖励策略，通过对推理中与关系相关的短语给予奖励，促使推理与关系标签对齐。该奖励源自从正确预测中自动提取的信用词典（credit dictionary）。我们的实验表明，该框架通过解决上述问题，同时提升了准确率和解释质量。
tldr: 该论文提出COGRE认知启发推理框架与HIT@DICT强化学习中间奖励策略，利用从正确预测中自动提取的信用词典派生奖励，引导大模型推理聚焦关系相关语义并与人类标注的抽象层次对齐，从而同时提升单样本关系抽取的准确率和解释质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes COGRE, a cognitively-inspired reasoning framework, and HIT@DICT, a reinforcement learning intermediate reward strategy that derives rewards from a credit dictionary automatically extracted from correct predictions, guiding LLM reasoning to focus on relation-relevant semantics and align with human abstraction levels, thereby improving both accuracy and explanation quality in one-shot relation extraction.
